_about: One video per page, keyed by page path. Hosting: Cloudflare R2 (Dean, 17 November 2026), set once in media_base; entries name only their files. A page shows nothing until its entry is ready AND not marked "live": false. Turn an entry on by deleting its "live": false line after the file is uploaded to R2. Never host the files on the site's own server. Fields: provider (file or youtube), file (path inside the bucket) or src (full https link), id (YouTube), poster, captions (.vtt), title, description, duration (PT1M20S), uploaded (YYYY-MM-DD), placement (beside = video above the chart, the default; replace = instead of the chart), live. Video files are made by the TFT studio (template ta_explainer). Checked by scripts/video.mjs at build time.

/rsi/.title: RSI: how it works
/rsi/.description: The relative strength index explained on real prices: how it is calculated and how traders read it.
